dialogues.speaker: Leone
dialogues.text: If I had to recommend something, it would be the magic show by the Great Magician Lyney and Lynette.

dialogues.speaker: Leone
dialogues.text: Their magic is truly a thing of surpassing beauty, and they also have many unexpected ideas!

dialogues.speaker: Leone
dialogues.text: That said, their performance times are as unpredictable as their magic tricks.

dialogues.speaker: Leone
dialogues.text: You would be very fortunate to meet them indeed.
